# Cross-kit contribution dispositions

Status: prepared local design packets, not upstream delivery or consumer adoption.
The owning maintainer reviews each proposal. No external issue/comment, automatic
fleet upgrade or consumer mutation is implied. Reuse and repair an existing seam
before extracting a new common protocol. Refresh exact destination revisions at
implementation admission; source references below describe owning contracts.

| Packet | Owner and seam | Proposed return and independent fixture | Disposition and delivery trigger |
|---|---|---|---|
| AK-HITL-01 / AK-PROSE-01 / AK-EVIDENCE-01 | app-kit presentation/accessibility | Anchor [PX tasks](prose-hitl-priority.md), queue, node inspector/diff and truthful states in [app-kit record](../../app-kit.md) | Priority local proposals under 0038. Admitted W3 task can precede IR-10; permanent components still need normal adoption bars. No upstream delivery claimed |
| AE-REVIEW-01 | platform-repo Review Kit typed criterion/finding/Track/Mark law | Paired practice pack and domain-validated exchange; PC-A08/09 refuse an invalid payload and missing execution receipt despite valid catalog identity | Local proposal, AE-3. Destination owns criterion semantics, floors and acceptance. Production migration stays AE-16/CK deferral |
| AE-CATALOG-01 | agentic-kit Catalog Kit verified bundle/tailoring/preparation | Typed practice/quality profile fixtures, catalog migration refusal and independent expected-scope witness; PC-A02/03/14 and PH-19 | Extend existing kit only where W1 reproduces a gap. No second catalog resolver, automatic shared lifecycle protocol or policy authority |
| AE-FATHOM-01 | Fathom evidence-provider/obligations/source-proof boundary | Synthetic source-snapshot/coverage fixtures and capability receipt; PV-16 no-index mode explicitly loses graph proof, and PC-A05 refuses location-only evidence | Prepared handoff. Actual Fathom answer-basis/receipt API must exist before binding; retain its F19/F20 triggers. O9/O11 and spawn routing are existing distinct defects, not declared repaired |
| AE-TEST-01 | platform-repo Test Kit execution and result provenance | Criterion/subject/definition-bound test result exchange, including no-run/failed/unsupported outcomes and artifact identity | Local proposal. AE-3 actual adapter must demonstrate the needed shape; no new generic test protocol before a shared gap is proven |
| AE-HOST-01 | agentic-kit native host adapter and agent-hooks | Shared-rule/version probes, delegated identity fixtures and safe sampling/existence examples; SH/HW failure cases | Local proposal, AE-13. Host-specific trust remains local; no global permissions change or unverified Antigravity adapter |

Every delivery record names originating task/revision, destination revision,
sanitized fixture, owner, accepted/rejected/deferred reason, actual upstream change,
originating consumer verification, and removed fork or retained divergence. A
packet is not marked returned until the owner has the change. A no-change result
is valid when the existing seam meets the fixture; retain its bounded evidence.

Public-project learning follows the same rule: record source code/doc revision,
license/use constraints, task/data/harness context, whether a claim is prescription
or observed result, counterexamples and applicability. Reuse a measured setting
only with a comparable workload trial. Do not copy private transcripts, exam items,
or assume a popular project's tuning transfers unchanged. Reviewed source patterns
become catalog candidates and regressions, never automatic configuration updates.
